column1: # Owner map of the multi-duelist core sites: which phase 2 or phase 3 task owns which code.
# Built from domain-core/.build/phase2/briefs/*.md, PLAN.md and P3-fold-design.md. Line numbers are B2 lines (they drift): prefer a function.
# Columns (tab separated): file, function ("*" = any; else the exact name a census row shows), lines ("-" = any, else "a-b"), task tag, note.
# A site matches a row when the file name is equal, the function matches, and the line is inside the range.
# A site with no function matches a row only when the row has a line range that holds the line.
# The first matching row is the owner. All matching rows are the candidates (owners.ts: ownersOf). No match = UNOWNED.
# Narrow rows (a line range, one function) come before wide rows (a whole file).
